rationale: Just added aggregation HP with 4 modes (median/mean/lcb/trimmed_lcb) and widened bag_frac/conf_lambda/n_bags ranges; the prior active_case xgb_meta_label_regime has produced 8 consecutive train-mode iterations with identical 4/7 +6.1% result (HP space saturated, see #1320-#1327). Hand the new aggregation × bag_frac × pos_class_weight × n_bags hypercube to train mode to find the median/trimmed_lcb sweet spot that today's manual default could not.
